description: Pages tests/a11y/axe-pages.mjs checks. path is relative to base. lang: the expected lang attribute (probe). signIn: true needs the signIn module. open: a selector to click before checking (a dialog, a drawer). skipLink: false for pages without repeated blocks. surface groups the summary. themeStorageKey: the localStorage key the app keeps a chosen theme in (so the run sets it), or null.
